title: Multimodal Graph Learning: A Survey of Models, Benchmarks, and Frontiers
abstract: arXiv:2611.12990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal attributed graphs (MAGs), in which nodes carry text, images, and other modalities while edges encode relations among entities, underlie e-commerce, social media, content platforms, and creative applications. Learning on MAGs has developed along two complementary lines: graph-centric methods redesign how modalities are fused, propagated, and connected within message passing, while foundation-model-centric methods pretrain transferable multimodal graph encoders or bring graph context into multimodal large language models for prediction and generation. In parallel, several benchmarks have appeared with different datasets and evaluation protocols. This survey takes an algorithm-centric and evaluation-grounded view of the field and makes three contributions. Modeling: we introduce a unified message-passing formulation and organize methods into five integration levels (feature, propagation, topology, learning, and foundation model),

translated_title: 多模态图学习：模型、基准与前沿综述
translated_abstract: 多模态属性图（MAGs）中的节点携带文本、图像和其他模态，而边编码实体之间的关系，这类图广泛应用于电子商务、社交媒体、内容平台和创意应用中。MAG上的学习沿着两条互补的路线发展：以图为中心的方法重新设计模态在消息传递中如何融合、传播和连接，而以基础模型为中心的方法则预训练可迁移的多模态图编码器，或将图上下文引入多模态大语言模型以进行预测和生成。与此同时，出现了多个采用不同数据集和评估协议的基准。本综述以算法为中心并以评估为基础的视角审视该领域，并做出三项贡献。建模方面：我们引入统一的消息传递公式，并将方法组织为五个集成层次（特征、传播、拓扑、学习和基础模型）。
tldr: 本综述针对多模态属性图学习，提出了统一的消息传递建模框架，将现有方法按五个集成层次（特征、传播、拓扑、学习和基础模型）分类，并系统梳理与评估了相关基准与前沿方向。
en_tdlr: This survey presents a unified message-passing formulation for multimodal attributed graph learning, organizes existing methods into five integration levels spanning features, propagation, topology, learning, and foundation models, and systematically reviews benchmarks and frontiers.
